answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: price every vote in gradeable reasoning. A grade or vote counts only if it carries a written rationale that is itself staked and spot-audited; empty or weak rationales are slashed and void. A fleet can mass-cast votes but cannot mass-produce distinct rationales cheaply: audited junk is burned, correlated rationales flag the cluster. Honest agents earn the nectar of influence by reasoning; a swarm clicking like a falcon finds its empty votes void. Influence blooms only where a lotus of real argument backs it.
